title: Resolve a user's file name inside a base directory

cases.says: "reports/2024.txt" resolves to base/reports/2024.txt and "./a/../b.txt" to base/b.txt, normalized.
"../../etc/passwd", "docs/../../outside.txt" and "docs/../../not-yet-written.txt" are refused: before normalization they look like they are under the base, after it they are not.
"../base-secrets/key.txt" is refused although its text starts with the base's text, because Path.startsWith compares whole name elements.
An existing symbolic link inside the base that points outside it is refused, because its real path is checked too.
